services.area: county excl. Annapolis city and BWI
services.evidence: The Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Division provides emergency and non-emergency medical services to the citizens of Anne Arundel County. ... Transport Unit Locations

services.name: Baltimore County Fire Department
services.evidence: The Baltimore County Fire Department (BCoFD) provides quality services to the citizens of and visitors to Baltimore County, including: Fire protection Emergency Medical Services

24005.page_note: Baltimore County Fire Department provides EMS with career and volunteer personnel. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who staffs the transporting units, and the role of volunteer companies.

services.name: Carroll County Department of Fire & EMS
services.evidence: a combined volunteer/career system where fire operations are run by both career and volunteer personnel, including 16 paramedic ambulances staffed by career employees of Carroll County Department of Fire Emergency Medical Services (DFEMS)

services.name: 14 volunteer Fire/EMS stations (unnamed)
services.evidence: CCDFEMS continues to develop and grow as an organization, providing administrative oversight to the 14 Volunteer Fire/EMS stations of the county.

24013.page_note: Confirmed: Carroll County Department of Fire & EMS. Not yet confirmed from a public source: which of its 14 volunteer fire/EMS stations transport.

services.name: Charles County volunteer EMS companies (14 EMS organizations incl. La Plata rescue squad, Ironsides, Dentsville, Charles County MICU Co. 60)
services.evidence: There are now 14 emergency medical service, (EMS), organizations, composed of 13 basic life support (BLS), companies, and 1 advanced life support (ALS), company in Charles County.

services.name: Charles County paid EMS/ALS staff (county employees)
services.area: Waldorf, La Plata, Bryans Road, Marbury, Newburg, Hughesville
services.evidence: paid EMS and ALS personnel supporting the system, (in Waldorf, La Plata, Bryans Road, Marbury, Newburg and Hughesville), they are county employees

24017.page_note: Charles County has 14 volunteer EMS organizations (including La Plata, Ironsides, Dentsville and MICU Company 60) plus county paid EMS staff. The county page is undated and the volunteer list may be incomplete.

services.name: Harford County Department of Emergency Services EMS Branch
services.evidence: The Department of Emergency Services EMS branch will deliver high quality emergency and prehospital care by Harford County paramedics and ambulances responding countywide.

services.name: Harford County Volunteer Fire and EMS Association / volunteer companies (unnamed)
services.evidence: the Harford County Volunteer Fire and EMS Association and the Harford County EMS Foundation

24025.page_note: Harford County Department of Emergency Services EMS Branch and volunteer fire and EMS companies provide service. Not yet confirmed from a public source: which individual volunteer companies transport.

services.name: Howard County Department of Fire & Rescue Services
services.evidence: statutorily responsible for administering the affairs of the county in fire suppression and prevention, fire training, arson investigation, rescue services and emergency medical services

24027.page_note: Every Howard County fire station has at least one engine and one paramedic unit. Not yet confirmed from a public source: ambulance transport by Howard County Department of Fire & Rescue Services.

services.name: Prince George's County Fire/EMS Department (career + volunteer companies)
services.evidence: Almost all fire stations have a basic life support ambulance in service. These 47 units are staffed by both career and volunteer personnel around the clock.

services.name: 12 ALS paramedic units
services.evidence: The AEMS office supervises 12 Paramedic Units that provide Advanced Life Support (ALS) to the entire county

24033.page_note: Prince George's County Fire/EMS Department and its volunteer companies provide transport, including 12 ALS paramedic units. Not yet confirmed from a public source: which volunteer companies (Laurel, Beltsville, Bowie, Kentland and others) own and run their ambulances.

services.evidence: This bill enables the Garrett County Commissioners to provide the statutorily required local funding for volunteer rescue squads

24023.page_note: Garrett County is served by volunteer rescue squads. Northern Garrett and Southern Garrett Rescue Squads and Bittinger VFD appear in 2025 commission minutes but are not yet confirmed from a county page.
